title: Kissed Tender Syrian Eggplant Skewers
description: A briny and tender Syrian dish featuring eggplant, perfect for a brunch mood, with a sweet and smoky flavor from palm sugar and nam tan pip, made lacto-vegetarian friendly and cooked to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the eggplant cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated eggplant cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Dehydrate the eggplant skewers in the oven at 150 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Grill the eggplant skewers on the robata grill for 10-12 minutes, or until tender and lightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together palm sugar and 2 tablespoons of water to make a glaze.
Brush the palm sugar glaze onto the grilled eggplant skewers during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the kissed tender Syrian eggplant skewers hot with a side of lacto-vegetarian friendly yogurt sauce.
To make the yogurt sauce, mix together yogurt, salt, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Refrigerate the yogurt sauce until ready to serve.
